resolved_conflicts.explanation: The first cabin is dated 1929 by the register and 1928 by FireLookout.com. The story gives both years.
The 1931 cab is an L-4 per the register and FireLookout.com, and an R-1 style gable-roof ground cabin per the WA lookouts list. The story gives both.
The register says removed in 1970 and FireLookout.com says destroyed in 1970. NPS says only that the building has since been removed, with no date.

notes_for_editor: Identity: the WA list's Clallam County Blue Mountain entry (Olympic National Park, 28N-5W-1) is taken to be this site; its 1959 item names Deer Park and the lookout station. Today's condition rests only on 2004 photo captions; no source read gives current access, so the brief's access value (unknown) stays unfilled. The NPS article is a coastal-defense history that describes Deer Park's fire lookout as used for Aircraft Warning Service. The 1959 quote is from a newspaper item as reprinted on the WA list, not from the paper itself. No photos added.
